lines.first_lantern.intro: Mabel: Mayor Bell calls this Hall a dead building. I call it a promise waiting on a match.
lines.first_lantern.gather: Mabel: Bring one bean crop and any fish. We will set the first lantern alight and settle Riverbend's access dispute.
lines.first_lantern.missing: Mabel: I still need one bean crop and any fish. Beans: {beans}; fish: {fish}.
lines.first_lantern.delivery: Mabel: Good. The beans will feed the wick and the fish oil will keep it through rain. Give me one moment at the lantern.
lines.first_lantern.light: Mabel: The wick is ready. Stand with me and light the first lantern.
lines.first_lantern.complete: The first lantern shines. Mabel joins Wayward Farm, the Hall begins to return, and Riverbend access is restored.
lines.first_lantern.after: Mabel keeps the first lantern bright. Helper unlocked: Mabel — ask her at Wayward Farm to water your crops.
lines.quest.first_lantern.title: The First Lantern
lines.quest.first_lantern.meet_mabel: Speak with Mabel at Six Brands Hall.
lines.quest.first_lantern.gather_provisions: Select and deliver one bean crop and one fish to Mabel.
lines.quest.first_lantern.light_lantern: Return to Mabel and light the first lantern.
lines.evidence.silas_first_lantern_note.title: Silas's Lantern Note
lines.evidence.silas_first_lantern_note.text: Evidence found — Silas's Lantern Note: ‘The Hall's first light still remembers the true rules. Do not let King choose the terms.’
lines.community.mayor_bell.meet: Bell trusts you with the courthouse claim.
lines.community.mayor_bell.favor: You compare the public deeds instead of repeating a rumor.
lines.community.mayor_bell.resolve: Bell resolves the claim fairly and offers a market introduction.
lines.dialogue.mayor_bell.meet.opening: Mayor Bell: The courthouse claim has drawn more rumor than careful listening. Hear the record before you judge it.
lines.dialogue.mayor_bell.meet.commit: Mayor Bell: I trust you with the courthouse claim. Return when you are ready to compare the public deeds.
lines.dialogue.mayor_bell.favor.opening: Mayor Bell: Two deeds describe the same boundary differently. Read both; do not repeat what the loudest claimant says.
lines.dialogue.mayor_bell.favor.commit: Mayor Bell: You compared the public deeds fairly. One final hearing can settle this without favor or spectacle.
lines.dialogue.mayor_bell.resolve.opening: Mayor Bell: The record is clear now. A fair settlement protects the claimant and the town together.
lines.dialogue.mayor_bell.resolve.commit: Mayor Bell: The claim is settled fairly. I will introduce Wayward Farm at the market and welcome claimants to an open hearing.
lines.community.river_rose.meet: Rose shows you the quiet bend.
lines.community.river_rose.favor: You map a safe current together.
lines.community.river_rose.resolve: Rose leaves a river guide in your tackle roll.
lines.community.dynamite_bill.meet: Bill asks you to inspect the safe side of the old rail.
lines.community.dynamite_bill.favor: You mark the dangerous ground without making a spectacle.
lines.community.dynamite_bill.resolve: Bill retires the fuse and teaches a composed opening.
lines.community.ada_rook.meet: Ada explains which bids are fair.
lines.community.ada_rook.favor: You help Ada rescue a mixed seed order.
lines.community.ada_rook.resolve: Ada opens her seed ledger and joins the farm roster.
lines.community.gideon_shaw.meet: Gideon introduces the animals by name.
lines.community.gideon_shaw.favor: You mend the tack before the evening game.
lines.community.gideon_shaw.resolve: Gideon takes a place on the daily animal roster.
lines.community.registrar_elise.meet: Elise lets you review a disputed testimony.
lines.community.registrar_elise.favor: You index records so a claimant can be heard.
lines.community.registrar_elise.resolve: Elise files the correction and shares a civic lead.
lines.community.constable_mara.meet: Mara asks you to walk the practice-hall beat.
lines.community.constable_mara.favor: You post a clear, accessible table-night notice.
lines.community.constable_mara.resolve: Mara calls fair play and stands ready for the championship.
lines.community.mariner_ves.meet: Ves shows you the dock's public manifest.
lines.community.mariner_ves.favor: You weigh a shipment without shaving its count.
lines.community.mariner_ves.resolve: Ves closes the ledger and backs your honest trade.
lines.community.captain_coral.meet: Coral teaches you to read the lantern tide.
lines.community.captain_coral.favor: You mend a net before the fog settles.
lines.community.captain_coral.resolve: Coral marks a lantern cove on your chart.
lines.community.witness_ash.meet: Ash asks you to read the weathered stones.
lines.community.witness_ash.favor: You tend the bonfire through an uneasy weather shift.
lines.community.witness_ash.resolve: Ash records a final witness statement for the coming confrontation.
lines.evidence.inheritance_deed.title: Silas's Inheritance Deed
lines.evidence.inheritance_deed.text: Silas left Wayward Farm to Doc with a margin note: keep the Hall's true rules in the open.
lines.evidence.investigation_chain_validated.t: The regional records agree: Silas followed the Hall's lawful rules to expose the bargain.
lines.evidence.silas_bargain_record.title: Silas's Bargain Record
lines.evidence.silas_bargain_record.text: King's bargain binds stakes to a truthful table, a bloodline, and the original Six Brands rules.
lines.evidence.silas_alive_signal.title: Silas's Signal
lines.evidence.silas_alive_signal.text: A living signal answers from King's Reach. Silas survived the bargain's prison.
lines.evidence.silas_bridlewood_ledger.title: Silas's Bridlewood Ledger
lines.evidence.silas_bridlewood_ledger.text: A ranch ledger shows Silas followed the barn accounts to a hidden Hall debt.
lines.evidence.silas_government_record.title: Silas's Government Record
lines.evidence.silas_government_record.text: The corrected public record proves the Hall bargain was hidden in plain sight.
lines.evidence.silas_cargo_ledger.title: Silas's Cargo Ledger
lines.evidence.silas_cargo_ledger.text: A dock manifest marks the route used to move the original counter-Deed.
lines.evidence.silas_gulls_rest_letter.title: Silas's Gull's Rest Letter
lines.evidence.silas_gulls_rest_letter.text: Silas asked Coral to keep the tide chart where King could not alter it.
lines.evidence.texas_king_counter_deed.title: Texas King's Counter-Deed
lines.evidence.texas_king_counter_deed.text: The exposed deed requires a truthful category and lets the Hall answer King's rule.
